  induction e generalizing inc with
  | Empty => simp [tveLookup]
  | Bind_tvar tvs e' ih => simp [tveLookup, ih]
  | Bind_name n' tvs t e' ih =>
    simp [tveLookup]
    split

    · exact ih inc

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End
-/
def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty, e => e
  | .Bind_tvar tvs e1, e2 => .Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t e1, e2 => .Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

/- HOL4:
Definition type_def_to_ctMap_def:
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp [] [] = []) ∧
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp ((tvs,tn,ctors)::tds) (id::ids) =
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE
      (MAP (\(cn,ts).
        (TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) ts, id)))
        ctors))
End
-/
def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →
    List type_ident → List (stamp × (List tvarN × List sem_t × type_ident))
  | [], [] => []
  | (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id_ :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    (ctors.map fun (cn, ts) =>
      (stamp.TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id_))).reverse
  | _, _ => []

/- HOL4:
Definition tenv_names_def[simp]:
  (tenv_names Empty = {}) ∧
  (tenv_names (Bind_tvar _ e) = tenv_names e) ∧
  (tenv_names (Bind_name n _ _ e) = n INSERT tenv_names e)
End
-/
def tenv_names : tenv_val_exp → Set mlstring
  | .Empty => ∅
  | .Bind_tvar _ e => tenv_names e
  | .Bind_name n _ _ e => {n} ∪ tenv_names e

/- HOL4:
Theorem check_freevars_add:
 (!tvs tvs' t. check_freevars tvs tvs' t ⇒
  !tvs''. tvs'' ≥ tvs ⇒ check_freevars tvs'' tvs' t)
-/
theorem check_freevars_add :
    ∀ (tvs : Nat) (tvs' : List tvarN) (t : sem_t),
      check_freevars tvs tvs' t →
      ∀ (tvs'' : Nat), tvs'' ≥ tvs → check_freevars tvs'' tvs' t := by
  intro tvs tvs' t
  induction tvs, tvs', t using check_freevars.induct with
  | case1 _ _ _ => intro h _ _; exact h
  | case2 dbmax tvs ts tn ih =>
    intro h tvs'' hle
    simp [check_freevars, List.all_eq_true] at h ⊢
    intro v hv
    have := h v hv
    exact ih v hv this tvs'' hle
  | case3 dbmax _ n =>
    intro h tvs'' hle
    simp [check_freevars] at h ⊢
    omega

/- HOL4:
Theorem subst_inc_cancel:
 (!t ts inc.
  deBruijn_subst 0 ts (deBruijn_inc 0 (inc + LENGTH ts) t)
  =
  deBruijn_inc 0 inc t) ∧
 (!ts' ts inc.
  MAP (deBruijn_subst 0 ts) (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (inc + LENGTH ts)) ts')
  =
  MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 inc) ts')

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

Definition type_pes_def:

        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)

def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)

Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:

(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End

def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty, e => e
  | .Bind_tvar tvs e1, e2 => .Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t e1, e2 => .Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp [] [] = []) ∧

    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE
      (MAP (\(cn,ts).
        (TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) ts, id)))
        ctors))

-/
def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →
    List type_ident → List (stamp × (List tvarN × List sem_t × type_ident))
  | [], [] => []

 !e1 e2. tenv_val_exp_ok (db_merge e1 e2) ⇒ tenv_val_exp_ok e2

    ∀ (e1 e2 : tenv_val_exp),
      tenv_val_exp_ok (db_merge e1 e2) → tenv_val_exp_ok e2 := by
  intro e1 e2 h
  induction e1 with
  | Empty => simpa [db_merge] using h
  | Bind_tvar tvs e1' ih =>
    apply ih
    simpa [db_merge, tenv_val_exp_ok] using h
  | Bind_name n' tvs t e1' ih =>
    apply ih
    simp [db_merge, tenv_val_exp_ok] at h
    exact h.2

    tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
    (n = inc + LENGTH targs) ∧

           p
           (deBruijn_subst inc targs' t)
           (MAP (\(x,t). (x, deBruijn_subst inc targs' t)) new_bindings)) ∧

    !targs' inc targs tvs.
    tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
    tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
    (n = inc + LENGTH targs) ∧
    EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
    (targs' = MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 inc) targs)
    ⇒
    type_ps (inc +  tvs) tenv

        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        n = inc + targs.length ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧

Theorem type_e_subst:
 (!tenv tenvE e t. type_e tenv tenvE e t ⇒

        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) →
        type_e tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2))
          e (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs' t)) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (es : List exp) (ts : List sem_t),
      type_es tenv tenvE es ts →
      ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (targs' : List sem_t),
        num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) →
        type_es tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2))
          es (ts.map (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs'))) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (funs : List (varN × varN × exp))
       (env : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_funs tenv tenvE funs env →
      ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (targs' : List sem_t),

        tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) →
        type_funs tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2))

/- HOL4:
Theorem nsLookup_add_tenvE3:
   !tenvE tenvV n t tvs2 mn.
    nsLookup tenvV (Long mn n) = SOME (tvs2,t) ⇒
    nsLookup (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV) (Long mn n) = SOME (tvs2,t)

theorem nsLookup_add_tenvE3 :
    ∀ (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (tenvV : tenv_val) (n : cml_id modN varN) (t : sem_t)

      nsLookup tenvV (.Long mn n) = some (tvs2, t) →
      nsLookup (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV) (.Long mn n) = some (tvs2, t) := by
  intro tenvE tenvV n t tvs2 mn h
  induction tenvE with
  | Empty => exact h
  | Bind_tvar _ _ ih => exact ih
  | Bind_name x tvs t' tenvE' ih =>
    simp [add_tenvE]
    cases hAE : add_tenvE tenvE' tenvV with
    | Bind vals mods =>
      simp [nsBind, nsLookup]
      rw [hAE] at ih
      simp [nsLookup] at ih
      exact ih

        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)

def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →

      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))

-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)

    REVERSE

def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →

Theorem tveLookup_db_merge_none:
 !n inc e1 e2.

      tveLookup n inc (db_merge e1 e2) = none ↔
      tveLookup n inc e1 = none ∧ tveLookup n (num_tvs e1 + inc) e2 = none := by
  intro n inc e1 e2
  induction e1 generalizing inc with
  | Empty =>
    simp [db_merge, tveLookup, num_tvs]
  | Bind_tvar tvs e1' ih =>
    simp [db_merge, tveLookup, num_tvs]
    rw [ih]
    have heq : num_tvs e1' + (inc + tvs) = tvs + num_tvs e1' + inc := by omega
    rw [heq]

    simp [db_merge, tveLookup, num_tvs]
    split
    · simp
    · exact ih inc

    ∀ (e1 e2 : tenv_val_exp),
      tenv_val_exp_ok (db_merge e1 e2) → tenv_val_exp_ok e2 := by
  intro e1 e2 h
  induction e1 with
  | Empty => simpa [db_merge] using h
  | Bind_tvar tvs e1' ih =>
    apply ih
    simpa [db_merge, tenv_val_exp_ok] using h
  | Bind_name n' tvs t e1' ih =>
    apply ih
    simp [db_merge, tenv_val_exp_ok] at h
    exact h.2

          (MAP (\(x,t). (x, deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs tenv2) (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs tenv2)) targs) t)) tenv1)

/-
  Translation of typeSysPropsScript.sml
  Theorems about the type system.
-/
import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
import LeanTypeSound.Ast

import LeanTypeSound.NamespaceProps

open HOL4

-- ============================================================
-- Definitions
-- ============================================================

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End
-/
def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty, e => e
  | .Bind_tvar tvs e1, e2 => .Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t e1, e2 => .Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

/- HOL4:
Definition type_def_to_ctMap_def:
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp [] [] = []) ∧
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp ((tvs,tn,ctors)::tds) (id::ids) =
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE
      (MAP (\(cn,ts).
        (TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) ts, id)))
        ctors))
End
-/
def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →
    List type_ident → List (stamp × (List tvarN × List sem_t × type_ident))
  | [], [] => []
  | (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id_ :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    (ctors.map fun (cn, ts) =>
      (stamp.TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id_))).reverse
  | _, _ => []

/- HOL4:
Definition tenv_names_def[simp]:
  (tenv_names Empty = {}) ∧
  (tenv_names (Bind_tvar _ e) = tenv_names e) ∧
  (tenv_names (Bind_name n _ _ e) = n INSERT tenv_names e)
End
-/
def tenv_names : tenv_val_exp → Set mlstring
  | .Empty => ∅
  | .Bind_tvar _ e => tenv_names e
  | .Bind_name n _ _ e => {n} ∪ tenv_names e

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End
-/
def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty, e => e
  | .Bind_tvar tvs e1, e2 => .Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t e1, e2 => .Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

/- HOL4:
Definition type_def_to_ctMap_def:
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp [] [] = []) ∧
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp ((tvs,tn,ctors)::tds) (id::ids) =
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE
      (MAP (\(cn,ts).
        (TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) ts, id)))
        ctors))
End
-/
def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →
    List type_ident → List (stamp × (List tvarN × List sem_t × type_ident))
  | [], [] => []
  | (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id_ :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    (ctors.map fun (cn, ts) =>
      (stamp.TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id_))).reverse

  (tenv_names Empty = {}) ∧

def tenv_names : tenv_val_exp → Set mlstring
  | .Empty => ∅
  | .Bind_tvar _ e => tenv_names e
  | .Bind_name n _ _ e => {n} ∪ tenv_names e

/-

-/
import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
import LeanTypeSound.Ast

import LeanTypeSound.TypeSystem
import LeanTypeSound.TypeSoundInvariants
import LeanTypeSound.NamespaceProps

open HOL4

-- ============================================================
-- Definitions
-- ============================================================

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End
-/
def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty, e => e
  | .Bind_tvar tvs e1, e2 => .Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t e1, e2 => .Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

/- HOL4:
Definition type_def_to_ctMap_def:
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp [] [] = []) ∧
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp ((tvs,tn,ctors)::tds) (id::ids) =
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE
      (MAP (\(cn,ts).
        (TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) ts, id)))
        ctors))
End
-/
def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →
    List type_ident → List (stamp × (List tvarN × List sem_t × type_ident))
  | [], [] => []
  | (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id_ :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    (ctors.map fun (cn, ts) =>
      (stamp.TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id_))).reverse
  | _, _ => []

/- HOL4:
Definition tenv_names_def[simp]:
  (tenv_names Empty = {}) ∧
  (tenv_names (Bind_tvar _ e) = tenv_names e) ∧
  (tenv_names (Bind_name n _ _ e) = n INSERT tenv_names e)
End
-/
def tenv_names : tenv_val_exp → Set mlstring
  | .Empty => ∅
  | .Bind_tvar _ e => tenv_names e
  | .Bind_name n _ _ e => {n} ∪ tenv_names e

/- HOL4:
Theorem check_freevars_add:

-/
theorem check_freevars_add :
    ∀ (tvs : Nat) (tvs' : List tvarN) (t : sem_t),
      check_freevars tvs tvs' t →
      ∀ (tvs'' : Nat), tvs'' ≥ tvs → check_freevars tvs'' tvs' t := by

  induction tvs, tvs', t using check_freevars.induct with

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:

        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)

def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=

    (tveLookup n inc tenv = SOME (tvs,t)))

theorem nsLookup_FOLDR_nsLift_some {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (e : «namespace» m n v) (p : List m) (id_ : cml_id m n) (val_ : v),

      nsLookupMod (FOLDR nsLift e p1) p2 = none ↔

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)
End
-/
def alistSub {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_compute_def:
  nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M

-/
def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop

  | [] => True

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End
-/
def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty, e => e
  | .Bind_tvar tvs e1, e2 => .Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t e1, e2 => .Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

/- HOL4:
Definition type_def_to_ctMap_def:
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp [] [] = []) ∧
  (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next_stamp ((tvs,tn,ctors)::tds) (id::ids) =
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE
      (MAP (\(cn,ts).
        (TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) ts, id)))
        ctors))
End
-/
def type_def_to_ctMap (tenvT : tenv_abbrev) (next_stamp : Nat) :
    List (List tvarN × mlstring × List (conN × List ast_t)) →
    List type_ident → List (stamp × (List tvarN × List sem_t × type_ident))
  | [], [] => []
  | (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, id_ :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    (ctors.map fun (cn, ts) =>
      (stamp.TypeStamp cn next_stamp, (tvs, ts.map (type_name_subst tenvT), id_))).reverse
  | _, _ => []

/- HOL4:
Definition tenv_names_def[simp]:
  (tenv_names Empty = {}) ∧

  (tenv_names (Bind_name n _ _ e) = n INSERT tenv_names e)

-/
def tenv_names : tenv_val_exp → Set mlstring
  | .Empty => ∅
  | .Bind_tvar _ e => tenv_names e
  | .Bind_name n _ _ e => {n} ∪ tenv_names e

    ∀ (skip : Nat) (tvs : List sem_t) (t : sem_t),
      check_freevars skip [] t →
      deBruijn_subst skip tvs t = t := by
  intro skip tvs t hcf
  induction t using deBruijn_inc.induct (skip := skip) with
  | case1 tv => simp [check_freevars] at hcf
  | case2 m hLt => simp [deBruijn_subst, hLt]
  | case3 m hNLt => simp [check_freevars] at hcf; omega
  | case4 ts tn ih =>
    simp [deBruijn_subst, check_freevars, List.all_eq_true] at hcf ⊢
    induction ts with
    | nil => simp
    | cons hd tl ih2 =>
      simp
      refine ⟨ih hd (by simp) (hcf hd (by simp)), ?_⟩
      apply ih2

Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M

/-
  Translation of typeSysPropsScript.sml
  Theorems about the type system.
-/
import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
import LeanTypeSound.Ast
import LeanTypeSound.Namespace
import LeanTypeSound.TypeSystem
import LeanTypeSound.TypeSoundInvariants
import LeanTypeSound.NamespaceProps
import LeanTypeSound.SemanticPrimitivesProps

open HOL4

-- ============================================================
-- Definitions
-- ============================================================

/- HOL4:
Definition type_pes_def:
  type_pes tvs tvs' tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 ⇔
    (∀(p,e)::set pes.
      ∃bindings.
        ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p []) ∧
        type_p tvs tenv p t1 bindings ∧
        type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) e t2)
End
-/
def type_pes (tvs tvs' : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
    (pes : List (pat × exp)) (t1 t2 : sem_t) : Prop :=
  ∀ pe, pe ∈ pes →
    ∃ bindings,
      ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings pe.1 []) ∧
      type_p tvs tenv pe.1 t1 bindings ∧
      type_e tenv (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) pe.2 t2

/- HOL4:
Definition deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def:
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) =
  Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
(deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
  Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
                                  (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs)
                                  t)
       (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env))
End
-/
def deBruijn_subst_tenvE (targs : List sem_t) : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp
  | .Empty => .Empty
  | .Bind_tvar tvs env => .Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)
  | .Bind_name x tvs t env =>
    .Bind_name x tvs
      (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env)
        (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env))) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

/- HOL4:
Definition db_merge_def:
(db_merge Empty e = e) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
(db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2))
End
-/
def db_merge : tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp → tenv_val_exp

theorem nsSub_nsBind {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (x : n) (v1_ : v1) (v2_ : v2)
      (e1 : «namespace» m n v1) (e2 : «namespace» m n v2),
      R (cml_id.Short x) v1_ v2_ ∧ nsSub R e1 e2 →
        nsSub R (nsBind x v1_ e1) (nsBind x v2_ e2) := by
  intro R x v1_ v2_ e1 e2 ⟨hR, hL, hM⟩
  cases e1 with
  | Bind v1s m1 =>
    cases e2 with
    | Bind v2s m2 =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro id w1 hLook
        cases id with
        | Short y =>
          simp [nsBind, nsLookup, ALOOKUP] at hLook
          by_cases hyx : x = y
          · subst hyx
            have : (x == x) = true := by simp
            rw [this] at hLook
            simp at hLook
            subst hLook
            exact ⟨v2_, by simp [nsBind, nsLookup, ALOOKUP, this], hR⟩
          · have hb : (x == y) = false := by simp; exact hyx
            rw [hb] at hLook
            simp at hLook
            have := hL (.Short y) w1 (by simp [nsLookup]; exact hLook)
            obtain ⟨w2, hw2, hRw⟩ := this
            refine ⟨w2, ?_, hRw⟩
            simp [nsBind, nsLookup, ALOOKUP, hb]
            simp [nsLookup] at hw2
            exact hw2
        | Long mn id' =>
          simp [nsBind, nsLookup] at hLook
          have := hL (.Long mn id') w1 (by simp [nsLookup]; exact hLook)
          obtain ⟨w2, hw2, hRw⟩ := this
          simp [nsLookup] at hw2
          exact ⟨w2, by simp [nsBind, nsLookup, hw2], hRw⟩
      · intro path hNone
        cases path with
        | nil => simp [nsBind, nsLookupMod] at hNone
        | cons mn rest =>
          simp [nsBind, nsLookupMod] at hNone
          have := hM (mn :: rest) (by simp [nsLookupMod]; exact hNone)
          simp [nsLookupMod] at this
          simp [nsBind, nsLookupMod]; exact this

Definition alist_rel_restr_def:

    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End

def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]

    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M

    ∀ (P Q : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : «namespace» m n v1) (e2 : «namespace» m n v2),

        nsSub P e1 e2 ∧ nsSub Q e1 e2 := by
  intro P Q e1 e2
  constructor
  · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, h2⟩, ⟨?_, h2⟩⟩
    · intro id v1_ hl
      obtain ⟨v2_, hv, hp, _⟩ := h1 id v1_ hl
      exact ⟨v2_, hv, hp⟩
    · intro id v1_ hl
      obtain ⟨v2_, hv, _, hq⟩ := h1 id v1_ hl
      exact ⟨v2_, hv, hq⟩
  · intro ⟨⟨hP1, hM⟩, ⟨hQ1, _⟩⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hM⟩
    intro id v1_ hl
    obtain ⟨v2_, hv, hp⟩ := hP1 id v1_ hl
    obtain ⟨v2_', hv', hq⟩ := hQ1 id v1_ hl
    rw [hv'] at hv
    cases hv
    exact ⟨v2_, hv', hp, hq⟩

  intro id v1 hl

/-

import LeanTypeSound.HOL4Prelude
import LeanTypeSound.Ast
import LeanTypeSound.Namespace

/- HOL4:
Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 (k1::keys) ⇔
    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

/- HOL4:
Definition alistSub_def:
  alistSub R e1 e2 ⇔ alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (MAP FST e1)
End
-/
def alistSub {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) : Prop :=
  alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 (e1.map Prod.fst)

/- HOL4:
Definition nsSub_compute_def:
  nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M
End
-/
def nsSub_compute {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [BEq n]
    (path : List m) (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) :
    «namespace» m n v1 → «namespace» m n v2 → Prop
  | .Bind e1V e1M, .Bind e2V e2M =>
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => R (mk_id path.reverse k) val1 val2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M
  decreasing_by all_goals sorry

/- HOL4: Theorem mk_id_thm: !id. mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id -/
theorem mk_id_thm {m n : Type} :
    ∀ (id : cml_id m n), mk_id (id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id) = id := by
  intro id
  induction id with

  intro id v1_ hl

Definition alist_rel_restr_def:
  (alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧

    case ALOOKUP l1 k1 of
    | NONE => F
    | SOME v1 =>
      case ALOOKUP l2 k1 of
      | NONE => F
      | SOME v2 => R k1 v1 v2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys)
End
-/
def alist_rel_restr {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k]
    (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (l1 : List (k × v1)) (l2 : List (k × v2)) :
    List k → Prop
  | [] => True
  | k1 :: keys =>
    match ALOOKUP l1 k1 with
    | none => False
    | some val1 =>
      match ALOOKUP l2 k1 with
      | none => False
      | some val2 => R k1 val1 val2 ∧ alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 keys

    alistSub (fun k val1 val2 => nsSub_compute (k :: path) R val1 val2) e1M e2M

/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsAppend -/
theorem nsAll_nsAppend {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (f : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (e1 e2 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAll f e1 ∧ nsAll f e2 → nsAll f (nsAppend e1 e2) := by
  have aLookup_app : ∀ {α β : Type} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α]
      (l1 l2 : List (α × β)) (k : α) (val : β),
      ALOOKUP (l1 ++ l2) k = some val →
      ALOOKUP l1 k = some val ∨ (ALOOKUP l1 k = none ∧ ALOOKUP l2 k = some val) := by
    intro α β _ _ l1 l2 k val h
    induction l1 with
    | nil => right; exact ⟨rfl, h⟩
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      obtain ⟨k', v'⟩ := hd
      by_cases hk : k' = k
      · have hb : (k' == k) = true := by simp [hk]
        simp [ALOOKUP, hb] at h
        left
        simp [ALOOKUP, hb]
        exact h
      · have hb : (k' == k) = false := by simp; exact hk
        simp [ALOOKUP, hb] at h
        rcases ih h with hL | ⟨hNone, hR⟩
        · left; simp [ALOOKUP, hb]; exact hL
        · right; refine ⟨?_, hR⟩; simp [ALOOKUP, hb]; exact hNone
  intro f e1 e2 ⟨h1, h2⟩
  cases e1 with
  | Bind v1 m1 =>
    cases e2 with
    | Bind v2 m2 =>
      intro id val hL
      cases id with
      | Short x =>
        simp [nsAppend, nsLookup] at hL
        rcases aLookup_app _ _ _ _ hL with h | ⟨_, h⟩
        · exact h1 (.Short x) val (by simp [nsLookup, h])
        · exact h2 (.Short x) val (by simp [nsLookup, h])
      | Long mn id' =>
        simp [nsAppend, nsLookup] at hL
        split at hL
        · contradiction
        · rename_i env hAp
          rcases aLookup_app _ _ _ _ hAp with hM | ⟨_, hM⟩
          · exact h1 (.Long mn id') val (by simp [nsLookup, hM]; exact hL)
          · exact h2 (.Long mn id') val (by simp [nsLookup, hM]; exact hL)

/- HOL4: Theorem nsAll_nsAppend_left -/
theorem nsAll_nsAppend_left {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (P : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (n1 n2 : «namespace» m n v),
      nsAll P (nsAppend n1 n2) → nsAll P n1 := by
  intro P n1 n2 h id val hL
  cases n1 with
  | Bind v1 m1 =>
    cases n2 with
    | Bind v2 m2 =>
      apply h id val
      cases id with
      | Short x =>
        simp [nsAppend, nsLookup] at hL ⊢
        rw [ALOOKUP] at hL ⊢
        -- Need: ALOOKUP (v1 ++ v2) x = some val
        clear h
        induction v1 with
        | nil => simp at hL
        | cons hd tl ih =>
          obtain ⟨k, v'⟩ := hd
          simp [ALOOKUP] at hL ⊢
          split
          · exact hL
          · exact ih hL
      | Long mn id' =>
        simp [nsAppend, nsLookup] at hL ⊢
        clear h
        -- Need to show that nsLookup lookup via (m1 ++ m2) succeeds
        cases hAp : ALOOKUP m1 mn with
        | none => rw [hAp] at hL; simp at hL

          rw [hAp] at hL
          -- Need: ALOOKUP (m1 ++ m2) mn = some env
          have aAppend : ALOOKUP (m1 ++ m2) mn = some env := by
            induction m1 with
            | nil => simp [ALOOKUP] at hAp
            | cons hd tl ih =>
              obtain ⟨k, e'⟩ := hd

              · exact ih hAp

/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_conj -/
theorem nsSub_conj {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (P Q : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : «namespace» m n v1) (e2 : «namespace» m n v2),
      nsSub (fun (id_ : cml_id m n) (x : v1) (y : v2) => P id_ x y ∧ Q id_ x y) e1 e2 ↔
        nsSub P e1 e2 ∧ nsSub Q e1 e2 := by
  intro P Q e1 e2
  constructor
  · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, h2⟩, ⟨?_, h2⟩⟩
    · intro id v1_ hl
      obtain ⟨v2_, hv, hp, _⟩ := h1 id v1_ hl
      exact ⟨v2_, hv, hp⟩
    · intro id v1_ hl
      obtain ⟨v2_, hv, _, hq⟩ := h1 id v1_ hl
      exact ⟨v2_, hv, hq⟩
  · intro ⟨⟨hP1, hM⟩, ⟨hQ1, _⟩⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hM⟩
    intro id v1_ hl
    obtain ⟨v2_, hv, hp⟩ := hP1 id v1_ hl
    obtain ⟨v2_', hv', hq⟩ := hQ1 id v1_ hl
    rw [hv'] at hv
    cases hv
    exact ⟨v2_, hv', hp, hq⟩
/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_refl -/
theorem nsSub_refl {m n v : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (P : cml_id m n → v → Prop) (R : cml_id m n → v → v → Prop),
      (∀ (n_ : cml_id m n) (x : v), P n_ x → R n_ x x) →
        ∀ (e : «namespace» m n v), nsAll P e → nsSub R e e := by
  intro P R hPR e hA
  refine ⟨?_, fun _ h => h⟩
  intro id v1 hl
  exact ⟨v1, hl, hPR id v1 (hA id v1 hl)⟩
/- HOL4: Theorem nsSub_nsBind -/
theorem nsSub_nsBind {m n v1 v2 : Type} [BEq m] [LawfulBEq m] [BEq n] [LawfulBEq n] :
    ∀ (R : cml_id m n → v1 → v2 → Prop) (x : n) (v1_ : v1) (v2_ : v2)
      (e1 : «namespace» m n v1) (e2 : «namespace» m n v2),
      R (cml_id.Short x) v1_ v2_ ∧ nsSub R e1 e2 →
        nsSub R (nsBind x v1_ e1) (nsBind x v2_ e2) := by
  intro R x v1_ v2_ e1 e2 ⟨hR, hL, hM⟩
  cases e1 with
  | Bind v1s m1 =>
    cases e2 with
    | Bind v2s m2 =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro id w1 hLook
        cases id with
        | Short y =>
          simp [nsBind, nsLookup, ALOOKUP] at hLook
          by_cases hyx : x = y
          · subst hyx
            have : (x == x) = true := by simp
            rw [this] at hLook
            simp at hLook
            subst hLook
            exact ⟨v2_, by simp [nsBind, nsLookup, ALOOKUP, this], hR⟩
          · have hb : (x == y) = false := by simp; exact hyx
            rw [hb] at hLook
            simp at hLook
            have := hL (.Short y) w1 (by simp [nsLookup]; exact hLook)
            obtain ⟨w2, hw2, hRw⟩ := this
            refine ⟨w2, ?_, hRw⟩
            simp [nsBind, nsLookup, ALOOKUP, hb]
            simp [nsLookup] at hw2
            exact hw2
        | Long mn id' =>
          simp [nsBind, nsLookup] at hLook
          have := hL (.Long mn id') w1 (by simp [nsLookup]; exact hLook)
          obtain ⟨w2, hw2, hRw⟩ := this
          simp [nsLookup] at hw2
          exact ⟨w2, by simp [nsBind, nsLookup, hw2], hRw⟩
      · intro path hNone
        cases path with
        | nil => simp [nsBind, nsLookupMod] at hNone
        | cons mn rest =>
          simp [nsBind, nsLookupMod] at hNone
          have := hM (mn :: rest) (by simp [nsLookupMod]; exact hNone)
          simp [nsLookupMod] at this
          simp [nsBind, nsLookupMod]; exact this

  rw [nsSub_conj, nsSub_conj]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨hP1, hQ1⟩, hP2, hQ2⟩; exact ⟨⟨hP1, hP2⟩, hQ1, hQ2⟩

Definition store_type_extension_def:

End

def store_type_extension (tenvS1 tenvS2 : tenv_store) : Prop :=

  intro l
  constructor

/- HOL4:
Theorem EVERY_LIST_REL[local]:
  EVERY (\x. f x y) l = LIST_REL (\x y. f x y) l (REPLICATE (LENGTH l) y)
-/
theorem EVERY_LIST_REL_local {α β : Type} :
    ∀ (f : α → β → Prop) (y : β) (l : List α),
      (∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → f x y) ↔ LIST_REL (fun x y => f x y) l (REPLICATE l.length y) := by
  intro f y l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [REPLICATE]; exact LIST_REL.nil
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine LIST_REL.cons _ _ _ _ (h hd (by simp)) (ih.mp (fun x hx => h x (by simp; right; exact hx)))
    · intro h x hx
      cases h with
      | cons _ _ _ _ hR hRest =>
        rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
        rcases hx with heq | hx
        · subst heq; exact hR
        · exact (ih.mpr hRest) x hx
